steps.prompt_exact: I've got a rainy-window cafe idea in my head: can you make it as a tiny playable browser game where drinks slide in, customers get impatient, and the whole thing fits in one pasteable HTML file with no outside assets?
steps.response_exact:
I’ll build it as one offline HTML file: cozy rainy-window café theme, sliding drink orders, impatient customers, score/strain loop, and simple mouse/touch controls. Here's the complete single-file HTML. Save as rainy-cafe.html and open in a browser. ☕🌧️ HTML Rainy Window Café

Rainy Window Café

Score: 0 Misses: 0/5 Shift: 60s
SLIDING DRINK RAIL
Nice serve

☕ Rainy Window Café

Drinks slide across the rail. Tap or drag each drink to the customer who ordered it before patience runs out.

Latte 🟤 · Tea 🟢 · Cocoa 🍫

Tip: click/tap a drink, then click/tap the matching customer. Dragging works too.
steps.response_summary: Initial one-file rainy café arcade game with sliding drinks, impatient customers, score/misses/timer, and mouse/touch serving.
